The first day is the one I really need. I can work the second day.
I've made a proposal and explained my specific need.

I've made my proposal. Now I'll wait to see how they react.

Okay.

scenario.shared_setting: Four staff run the front counter at a small branch office and have worked together for two years. Two of them are needed on duty every working day, and there are no relief staff. Leave requests for next month go to head office tonight, and there is no rule about whose leave comes first. The roster for the days around Christmas is also still open. You all know each other's faith and what each of you eats: Natalie Rodrigues is Catholic, Marcus de Souza is Catholic, Rachel Pereira is Catholic, and Aisyah is Muslim and eats halal. It is the end of the working day, and all four are behind the counter.
